# U.S. Fire Administration

> > The lead federal agency providing fire data, education, research, training, and incident reporting systems to advance fire safety and emergency services across the nation.

USFA is part of FEMA and operates the National Fire Academy (NFA) in Emmitsburg, Maryland, offering professional development courses and specialized leadership programs. The agency maintains the National Fire Incident Reporting System (NFIRS), the primary database for fire incident data in the United States, and is transitioning to the National Emergency Response Information System (NERIS) by 2026.

## Key Topics

- National Fire Academy
- Fire incident reporting
- NFIRS (National Fire Incident Reporting System)
- NERIS (National Emergency Response Information System)

## Fire Incident Reporting (NFIRS)

- [National Fire Incident Reporting System](https://www.usfa.fema.gov/nfirs): NFIRS documentation, training, coding help, and reporting guidelines
- [NFIRS Documentation](https://www.usfa.fema.gov/nfirs/documentation): NFIRS 5.0 technical documentation and specifications for vendors and users
- [eNFIRS Applications](https://www.usfa.fema.gov/nfirs/applications): eNFIRS software tools and applications for fire department incident reporting
- [NFIRS Training](https://www.usfa.fema.gov/nfirs/training): NFA courses and tutorial videos for NFIRS users and data warehouse access
- [NFIRS Coding Help](https://www.usfa.fema.gov/nfirs/coding-help): NFIRS coding support, bulletins, and incident documentation guidance
- [NFIRS Sunset](https://www.usfa.fema.gov/nfirs/sunset): NFIRS transition guidelines and FAQs for 2026 system migration to NERIS

## National Fire Academy

- [About the National Fire Academy](https://www.usfa.fema.gov/nfa/about): NFA overview, specialized training courses, and management programs
- [National Fire Academy Courses](https://www.usfa.fema.gov/nfa/courses): NFA course catalog for fire service professional development and training
- [National Fire Academy Distinctive Programs](https://www.usfa.fema.gov/nfa/programs): NFA executive and officer leadership development programs for fire service
- [National Emergency Training Center Admissions Office](https://www.usfa.fema.gov/nfa/admissions): NFA application requirements, eligibility, and admissions information
- [National Fire Academy: On-Campus Students](https://www.usfa.fema.gov/nfa/on-campus-students): Student housing, campus services, dining, and orientation information

## Organization & Resources

- [U.S. Fire Administration](https://www.usfa.fema.gov): USFA homepage: lead federal agency for fire data, education, research, and training
- [About the U.S. Fire Administration](https://www.usfa.fema.gov/about): USFA mission, organization overview, and fire prevention initiatives
- [National Emergency Training Center Library](https://www.usfa.fema.gov/library): Nation's fire and emergency management library with research assistance
- [Contact the U.S. Fire Administration](https://www.usfa.fema.gov/contact.html): Contact information, phone numbers, emails, and mailing addresses
